caption:
Six rules monitor your trading account on official broker APIs. Configure max_daily_loss, profit_target, max_trades, kill_time, kill_days, and kill_dates to enforce discipline before manual control slips. When any limit breaches, KaatDo cancels every pending order and squares off every position at market, keeping your account locked until close while re-firing if trading activity reappears.
